about: The greedy-token check's prompts (anatomy.tidy.agreement): eight natural-text openings, tokenised once with each family's pinned tokenizer (the tokenizers' tokenizer.json at the revision named), so every engine is given the same ids. Natural text, not random ids: random prompts give near-tied logits, where correct bf16 engines part within a few tokens. Each unit generates 32 greedy tokens per prompt at batch 1, after its last timed wave. Llama 3's ids begin with its BOS (128000); Qwen3 adds none.
